**q25.** Engine: Google CEL (`github.com/google/cel-go`) wrapped by the in-repo filter engine at `internal/filter/` (`engine.go:12` `Engine`, schema `schema.go:89`, parser `parser.go`, SQL renderer `render.go`). Mechanism: the handler validates/collects filter strings (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_filter.go`, passed as `store.FindMemo.Filters`, `store/memo.go:69`), and each dialect driver calls `filter.DefaultEngine()` + `filter.AppendConditions(ctx, engine, find.Filters, filter.Dialect{SQLite|Postgres|MySQL}, &where, &args)` (`store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57-61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:54-58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:65-69`), which compiles CEL → a dialect-agnostic condition tree → dialect-specific SQL fragment + args via `renderer.Render` (`internal/filter/render.go:32`, dialect templates in `internal/filter/schema.go:105-135`).

**q26.** `memo` (the memo row plus all its comment memo rows), `memo_relation` (both directions), `attachment` (rows + backing storage). Additionally `memo_share` is removed by the DB-level `FOREIGN KEY (memo_id) REFERENCES memo(id) ON DELETE CASCADE` on MySQL/Postgres (`store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql:108`, `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql:108`) — note SQLite opens with `_pragma=foreign_keys(0)` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53`), so that cascade does not fire there. `reaction` rows are **not** deleted.

**q27.** Mechanism: the built `web/dist` output is compiled into the binary with Go `embed.FS` and served by Echo's static middleware plus an SPA `index.html` fallback. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-21` (`//go:embed dist/*`), `frontend.go:40-59` (`Serve`, static middleware + `spaFallbackMiddleware`), invoked from `server/server.go:69`.

**q28.**
```
s3presign.Runner — started in Server.startBackgroundRunners (server/server.go:157-166):
                   RunOnce immediately at startup, then a 12h time.Ticker
                   (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:26,29-39)
internal/webhook async dispatch workers — 4 goroutines started by package init(),
                   driven by the buffered asyncPostQueue (internal/webhook/webhook.go:38,42-54)
```
Unused infrastructure:
- `internal/scheduler` (full cron scheduler package with README/middleware/parser) is **not** used by the server — it is only imported by its own tests (`internal/scheduler/example_test.go:10`, `integration_test.go:13`).
- `server/runner/memopayload.Runner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:14-26`) is never constructed/started; only its `RebuildMemoPayload` helper is called inline from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`.

**q29.** Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:147-172`, applied to the shared Connect transport (`web/src/connect.ts:178`). Tokens it manages: a short-lived JWT **access token** (attached as `Authorization: Bearer …`, stored/refreshed via `web/src/auth-state.ts`, proactive expiry refresh + reactive 401 retry) and a long-lived **refresh token** delivered as an httpOnly cookie (`credentials: "include"`, refreshed via `AuthService.RefreshToken` on a separate no-interceptor transport, `web/src/connect.ts:64-80`). Backend validation package: `server/auth` (`server/auth/authenticator.go`, `server/auth/token.go` — access token JWT `user.access-token`, refresh token `user.refresh-token` cookie `memos_refresh`, plus `memos_pat_` Personal Access Tokens), driven through `NewAuthorizer`/`NewAuthInterceptor` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:66,136` and `server/router/api/v1/authz.go`.

**q30.**
```
memo created:         APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook        — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15
memo updated:         APIV1Service.DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook        — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:20
memo deleted:         APIV1Service.DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook        — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:25
memo comment created: APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:30
```
The first three converge on `APIV1Service.dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:47`); all four then converge on `webhook.PostAsync` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`), whose queue workers perform delivery in `webhook.Post` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`).
